title: Figure 3: Two commercially available EEG sensors - NeuroSky MindSet and OCZ nia headband
description: Product photographs under the heading "Commercial EEG sensors": a blue over-ear headset labeled "MindSet, by NeuroSky" and a black headband with diamond-shaped sensor pads labeled "nia, by OCZ Technology." The caption "Figure 3. Two Commercially Available EEG Sensors" explains the MindSet uses two sensors (right earphone and forehead) while the nia records from three forehead sensors. Text below discusses dry-electrode EEG accuracy and MEG-based BMI systems.
